info.name: AlayaCare Accounting Accounts Employee Skills API
Get a list of an employee's skills by the employee AlayaCare ID

params.name: employee_id
params.description: The AlayaCare ID of a employee

params.name: page
params.description: Filter by page number.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of items per page.

params.name: filter
params.description: Substring search on skill category and name

params.name: category_id
params.description: Filter skills by category ID, one or more using **OR**

items.docs: Get a list of an employee's skills by the employee AlayaCare ID

info.name: Create an employee specific skill by the employee AlayaCare ID

params.name: employee_id
params.description: The AlayaCare ID of a employee

items.docs:
- Skill fields (`acquired_date`, `expired_date`,  `label_1` and `label_2`) should only be included if they are configured on the skill master list.
- `comment` can only be set if one or more skill field is configured on the skill master list. 
- Employee must have a status of active, pending, on hold, suspended, or applicant to have skills assigned.

info.name: Update an employee's skill by the employee AlayaCare ID

params.name: employee_id
params.description: The AlayaCare ID of an employee

params.name: skill_id
params.description: The AlayaCare ID of a skill

items.docs:
- Skill fields sent in the payload will overwrite existing fields on the employee skill.
- Skill fields (`acquired_date`, `expired_date`,  `label_1` and `label_2`) should only be included if they are configured on the skill master list.
- `comment` can only be set if one or more skill field is configured on the skill master list. 
- Employee must have a status of active, pending, on hold, suspended, or applicant to have skills assigned.

info.name: Remove a employee's skill by the employee AlayaCare ID

params.name: employee_id
params.description: The AlayaCare ID of an employee

params.name: skill_id
params.description: The AlayaCare ID of a skill

items.docs: - Employee must have a status of active, pending, on hold, suspended, or applicant to have skills unassigned.
